title: Jeep J-Series Engines by Year (1972–1988)
description: Every factory engine in the Jeep J-series pickup by year, 1972–1988: AMC's 258 six and 304, 360 and 401 V8s in the J10 and J20 trucks.
intro: The Jeep pickup sold as the Gladiator from 1963 was renamed the J-series for 1972 and built until 1988. The J10 was the half-ton; the heavier J20 always came with a V8. Jeep's truck literature stopped quoting horsepower after 1973, so most later years show no rating. The 1963–1971 trucks are on the Gladiator page.
Pick a year to see every engine offered that model year, with its code, rated horsepower and the trims it came in. Each engine links to its full specs.
The J-series used AMC's 258 six (J10 only) and its 304, 360 and 401 V8s.
